#### Metrics

```{r outliers VR outcome, BFMC}
##AUC differences with DeLong

df$petstat <- as.factor(df$VR_overall)


biomarkers <- c("ptau217","PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
results_delong <- list()
index <- 1

for (i in seq_along(biomarkers)){
  for (j in seq_along(biomarkers)){ 
    if (i < j) {
      predictor1 <- biomarkers[i]
      predictor2 <- biomarkers[j]
 
      formula1 <- as.formula(paste("petstat~",predictor1, collapse=""))
      formula2 <- as.formula(paste("petstat~",predictor2, collapse=""))
      
      roc_curve1 <- pROC::roc(formula1, data=df.outlier, quiet=T)
      roc_curve2 <- pROC::roc(formula2, data=df.outlier,quiet=T)
      
      res <- roc.test(roc_curve1, roc_curve2, method = "delong")
      
      long <- data.frame(
        comp = paste(predictor1, predictor2, sep=" vs. "),
        auc1a = round(roc_curve1$auc,3),
        auc2a = round(roc_curve2$auc,3),
        pval = round(res$p.value,3),
        auc1_ci_low = round(ci.auc(roc_curve1)[1],3),
        auc1_ci_high =round(ci.auc(roc_curve1)[3],3),
        auc2_ci_low =round(ci.auc(roc_curve2)[1],3),
        auc2_ci_high = round(ci.auc(roc_curve2)[3],3)
        )
      
      results_delong[[length(results_delong) + 1]] <- long
      index <- index + 1
    }
  }
}

results_delong <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, results_delong)
results_delong$padj <- round(p.adjust(results_delong$pval, method = "fdr"),3)
results_delong$auc_order <- c(results_delong$auc1a[1],results_delong$auc1a[3], results_delong$auc2a[3])
results_delong$auc_order_ci_low <- c(results_delong$auc1_ci_low[1],results_delong$auc1_ci_low[3], results_delong$auc2_ci_low[3])
results_delong$auc_order_ci_high <- c(results_delong$auc1_ci_high[1],results_delong$auc1_ci_high[3], results_delong$auc2_ci_high[3])
openxlsx::write.xlsx(results_delong,
                     file="~/DELONG_VR_outliers.xlsx")


df.outlier$petstat <- as.factor(df.outlier$VR_overall)
df.outlier <- df.outlier %>% drop_na(csf_4240)

df.outlier$ptau217_pos <- ifelse(df.outlier$ptau217 >= 0.23211, 1, 0) 
df.outlier$ptau217_neg <- ifelse(df.outlier$ptau217 <= 0.08681, 0, 1)

df.outlier$ptau217ab42_pos <- ifelse(df.outlier$PL_217_42 >= 0.00738, 1, 0) 
df.outlier$ptau217ab42_neg <- ifelse(df.outlier$PL_217_42 <= 0.00370, 0, 1)

df.outlier$ab4240_pos <- ifelse(df.outlier$csf_4240 <= 0.072, 1, 0)
df.outlier$ab4240_pos2 <- ifelse(df.outlier$csf_4240 <= 0.058, 1, 0)

#Step 1: 1 cutoff

##Calculate Accuracy, PPV, NPV and 95% CIs

f_comp_stats <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data[indices,])
  
  ##threshold calculation related to d, and then assign binary status based on that threshold
  compute_metrics <- function(true, pred) {
    
    ##threshold calculation and 
    
    v_tp <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 1)
    v_fp <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 1)
    v_tn <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 0)
    v_fn <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 0)
    
    sens <- v_tp / (v_tp + v_fn)
    spec <- v_tn / (v_tn + v_fp)
    acc <- (v_tp + v_tn) / (v_tp + v_tn + v_fn + v_fp)
    ppv <- cutpointr::ppv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    npv <- cutpointr::npv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    
    return(c(acc, ppv, npv, sens, spec, v_tp, v_fp, v_tn, v_fn))#sens#spec
  }
  
  test_columns <- c("ptau217_pos","ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  results <- matrix(nrow = length(test_columns), ncol = 9)
  colnames(results) <- c("Accuracy", "PPV", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN")
  rownames(results) <- c("ptau217", "PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_columns)) {
    results[i, ] <- round(compute_metrics(d$petstat, d[[test_columns[i]]]),3)
  }
  
  #Assign p-tau217 metrics
  acc1 <- results[1,1]
  ppv1 <- results[1,2]
  npv1 <- results[1,3]
  sens1 <- results[1,4]
  spec1 <- results[1,5]
  tp1 <- results[1,6]
  fp1 <- results[1,7]
  tn1 <- results[1,8]
  fn1 <- results[1,9]
  
  #Assign p-tau217/AB42 metrics
  acc2 <- results[2,1]
  ppv2 <- results[2,2]
  npv2 <- results[2,3]
  sens2 <- results[2,4]
  spec2 <- results[2,5]
  tp2 <- results[2,6]
  fp2 <- results[2,7]
  tn2 <- results[2,8]
  fn2 <- results[2,9]
  
  #Assign CSF metrics
  acc3 <- results[3,1]
  ppv3 <- results[3,2]
  npv3 <- results[3,3]
  sens3 <- results[3,4]
  spec3 <- results[3,5]
  tp3 <- results[3,6]
  fp3 <- results[3,7]
  tn3 <- results[3,8]
  fn3 <- results[3,9]
  
  #p-tau217 vs. 217/ab42
  diff_acc_217_217ab42 <- acc1 - acc2
  diff_ppv_217_217ab42 <- ppv1 - ppv2
  diff_npv_217_217ab42 <- npv1 - npv2
  diff_sens_217_217ab42 <- sens1 - sens2
  
  #p-tau217 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217_csf <- acc1 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217_csf <- ppv1 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217_csf <- npv1 - npv3
  diff_sens_217_csf <- sens1 - sens3
  
  #217/ab42 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217ab42_csf <- acc2 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217ab42_csf <- ppv2 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217ab42_csf <- npv2 - npv3
  diff_sens_217ab42_csf <- sens2 - sens3
  
  return(c(acc1, acc2, acc3, ppv1, ppv2, ppv3, npv1, npv2, npv3,#9
           diff_acc_217_217ab42, diff_ppv_217_217ab42, diff_npv_217_217ab42,#12
           diff_acc_217_csf,diff_ppv_217_csf,diff_npv_217_csf, #15
           diff_acc_217ab42_csf, diff_ppv_217ab42_csf,diff_npv_217ab42_csf,#18
           sens1, sens2, sens3, spec1, spec2, spec3, #24
           diff_sens_217_217ab42,diff_sens_217_csf, diff_sens_217ab42_csf, #27
           tp1, fp1, tn1, fn1, tp2, fp2, tn2, fn2, tp3, fp3, tn3, fn3)) #31 #35 #39
}   

set.seed(12345)
boot_results <- boot(data = df.outlier, statistic = f_comp_stats, R = 2000)

#Calculate pvalues 1 cutoff
stat_indices <- list(
  "Accuracy 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 10,
  "PPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 11,
  "NPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 12,
  "Accuracy 217 vs. CSF" = 13,
  "PPV pval 217 vs. CSF" = 14,
  "NPV pval 217 vs. CSF" = 15,
  "Accuracy 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 16,
  "PPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 17,
  "NPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 18)

pvals_1cp <- data.frame(
  Pval = numeric(length(stat_indices)),
  row.names = c("Accuracy 217 vs. 217_AB42","PPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42","NPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42","Accuracy 217 vs. CSF","PPV pval 217 vs. CSF","NPV pval 217 vs. CSF","Accuracy 217ab42 vs. CSF","PPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF","NPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF"))

bootstrap_replicates <- boot_results$t
for (stat_name in names(stat_indices)) {
  index <- stat_indices[[stat_name]]
  boot_diff <- boot_results$t0[index]
  results_underH0_diff <- bootstrap_replicates[, index] - mean(bootstrap_replicates[, index])
  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_1cp[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

##Add outcomes to dataframe (function to establish dataframe as desired)
create_df <- function(method_name, boot_acc_index, boot_ppv_index, boot_npv_index, boot_sen_index, boot_spec_index,boot_tp_index,boot_fp_index,boot_tn_index,boot_fn_index) {
  data.frame(
    method = method_name,
    accuracy = round(boot_results$t0[boot_acc_index], 3),
    acc_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    acc_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    PPV = round(boot_results$t0[boot_ppv_index], 3),
    ppv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    ppv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    NPV = round(boot_results$t0[boot_npv_index], 3),
    npv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    npv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Sensitivity =round(boot_results$t0[boot_sen_index], 3),
    sen_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    sen_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Specificity = round(boot_results$t0[boot_spec_index], 3),
    spec_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    spec_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    TP = round(boot_results$t0[boot_tp_index], 0),
    FP = round(boot_results$t0[boot_fp_index], 0),
    TN = round(boot_results$t0[boot_tn_index], 0),
    FN = round(boot_results$t0[boot_fn_index], 0),
    intermediate_n_percentage = NA,
    intermediate_n_percentage_low = NA,
    intermediate_n_percentage_high = NA,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    row.names = "1 Cutpoint"
  )
}

results_1cp_1 <- create_df(method_name = "Plasma p-tau217",boot_acc_index = 1,boot_ppv_index = 4,boot_npv_index = 7, boot_sen_index=19, boot_spec_index=22,boot_tp_index = 28, boot_fp_index=29, boot_tn_index=30, boot_fn_index=31)

results_1cp_3 <- create_df(method_name = "CSF AB42/40",boot_acc_index = 3,boot_ppv_index = 6,boot_npv_index = 9, boot_sen_index=21, boot_spec_index=24,boot_tp_index = 36, boot_fp_index=37, boot_tn_index=38, boot_fn_index=39)

#Step 2: establish the intermediate zone

df.outlier <- df.outlier %>%
  mutate(greyzone_ptau217 = case_when(
    ptau217_neg == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0
    ptau217_pos == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1
    TRUE ~ 2                     # Intermediate values
  ))

df.outlier <- df.outlier %>%
  mutate(greyzone_ptau217ab42 = case_when(
    ptau217ab42_neg == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0
    ptau217ab42_pos == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1
    TRUE ~ 2                     # Intermediate values
  ))

df.outlier <- df.outlier %>%
  mutate(greyzone_ab4240 = case_when(
    ab4240_pos == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0
    ab4240_pos2 == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1
    TRUE ~ 2                     # Intermediate values
  ))

##Function to bootstrap %intermediate
f_greyzone <- function(data, indices){
  d <- data[indices, ]
  
  test_bio <- c("ptau217","PL_217_42", "csf_ab4240")
  pred_pos <- c("ptau217_pos", "ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  pred_neg <- c("ptau217_neg", "ptau217ab42_neg", "ab4240_pos2")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_bio)) {
    greyzone_col <- paste0("greyzone_", test_bio[i])
    neg_col <- pred_neg[i]
    pos_col <- pred_pos[i]
    
    d <- d %>%
      mutate(!!greyzone_col := case_when(
        !!sym(neg_col) == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0
        !!sym(pos_col) == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1
        TRUE ~ 2
      ))  
  }
  
  int_n_ptau217 <- length(which(d$greyzone_ptau217 ==2))
  int_perc_ptau217 <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_ptau217 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
  
  int_n_ptau217ab42 <- length(which(d$greyzone_PL_217_42 ==2))
  int_perc_ptau217ab42 <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_PL_217_42 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
  
  int_n_csf <- length(which(d$greyzone_ab4240 ==2))
  int_perc_csf <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_ab4240 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
  
  #DIFFERENCES BETWEEN ASSAYS
  diff_perc_ptau217_ptau217ab42 <- int_perc_ptau217 - int_perc_ptau217ab42
  diff_perc_ptau217_csf <- int_perc_ptau217 - int_perc_csf
  diff_perc_ptau217ab42_csf <- int_perc_ptau217ab42 - int_perc_csf
  
  return(c(int_perc_ptau217, int_perc_ptau217ab42,int_perc_csf,
           diff_perc_ptau217_ptau217ab42, diff_perc_ptau217_csf, diff_perc_ptau217ab42_csf))
}

set.seed(12345)
boot_results_greyzone <- boot(data = df.outlier, statistic = f_greyzone, R = 2000)

##Calculate pvalue %intermediate differences
stat_indices <- list("Int% pval p-tau217 vs. p-tau217/AB42" = 4 , 
                     "Int% pval p-tau217 vs. CSF" = 5, 
                     "Int% pval p-tau217/AB42 vs.CSF" = 6)

pvals_intermediate <- data.frame(
  Pval = numeric(length(stat_indices)),
  row.names = c("Int% pval p-tau217 vs. p-tau217/AB42","Int% pval p-tau217 vs. CSF","Int% pval p-tau217/AB42 vs.CSF"))

bootstrap_replicates_grey <- boot_results_greyzone$t

for (stat_name in names(stat_indices)) {
  index <- stat_indices[[stat_name]]
  boot_diff <- boot_results_greyzone$t0[index]
  results_underH0_diff <- bootstrap_replicates_grey[, index] - mean(bootstrap_replicates_grey[, index])
  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_intermediate[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

#Step 3: Two cutoff approach

f_comp_stats_2cp <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data[indices,])
  
  
  compute_metrics <- function(d,greyzone, true, pred) {
    
    dx <- d %>% filter(!!sym(greyzone) != 2)
    
    v_tp <- sum(dx[[true]] == 1 & dx[[pred]] == 1)
    v_fp <- sum(dx[[true]] == 0 & dx[[pred]] == 1)
    v_tn <- sum(dx[[true]] == 0 & dx[[pred]] == 0)
    v_fn <- sum(dx[[true]] == 1 & dx[[pred]] == 0)
    
    sens <- v_tp / (v_tp + v_fn)
    spec <- v_tn / (v_tn + v_fp)
    acc <- (v_tp + v_tn) / (v_tp + v_tn + v_fn + v_fp)
    ppv <- cutpointr::ppv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    npv <- cutpointr::npv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    
    return(c(acc, ppv, npv, sens, spec, v_tp, v_fp, v_tn, v_fn))#sens#spec
  }
  
  greyzones <- c("greyzone_ptau217", "greyzone_ptau217ab42","greyzone_ab4240")
  test_columns <- c("ptau217_pos","ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  true_label <- "petstat"
  
  results <- matrix(nrow = length(test_columns), ncol =9)
  colnames(results) <- c("Accuracy", "PPV", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN")
  rownames(results) <- c("ptau217", "PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_columns)) {
    results[i, ] <- round(compute_metrics(d, greyzone = greyzones[i], true = true_label, pred = test_columns[i]),3)
  }
  
  #P-tau217
  acc1 <- results[1,1]
  ppv1 <- results[1,2]
  npv1 <- results[1,3]
  sens1 <- results[1,4]
  spec1 <- results[1,5]
  tp1 <- results[1,6]
  fp1 <- results[1,7]
  tn1 <- results[1,8]
  fn1 <- results[1,9]
  
  #P-tau217/AB42
  acc2 <- results[2,1]
  ppv2 <- results[2,2]
  npv2 <- results[2,3]
  sens2 <- results[2,4]
  spec2 <- results[2,5]
  tp2 <- results[2,6]
  fp2 <- results[2,7]
  tn2 <- results[2,8]
  fn2 <- results[2,9]
  
  #CSF
  acc3 <- results[3,1]
  ppv3 <- results[3,2]
  npv3 <- results[3,3]
  sens3 <- results[3,4]
  spec3 <- results[3,5]
  tp3 <- results[3,6]
  fp3 <- results[3,7]
  tn3 <- results[3,8]
  fn3 <- results[3,9]
  
  #p-tau217 vs. 217/ab42
  diff_acc_217_217ab42 <- acc1 - acc2
  diff_ppv_217_217ab42 <- ppv1 - ppv2
  diff_npv_217_217ab42 <- npv1 - npv2
  diff_sens_217_217ab42 <- sens1 - sens2
  
  #p-tau217 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217_csf <- acc1 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217_csf <- ppv1 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217_csf <- npv1 - npv3
  diff_sens_217_csf <- sens1 - sens3
  
  #217/ab42 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217ab42_csf <- acc2 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217ab42_csf <- ppv2 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217ab42_csf <- npv2 - npv3
  diff_sens_217ab42_csf <- sens2 - sens3
  
  return(c(acc1, acc2, acc3, ppv1, ppv2, ppv3, npv1, npv2, npv3,#9
           diff_acc_217_217ab42, diff_ppv_217_217ab42, diff_npv_217_217ab42,#12
           diff_acc_217_csf,diff_ppv_217_csf,diff_npv_217_csf, #15
           diff_acc_217ab42_csf, diff_ppv_217ab42_csf,diff_npv_217ab42_csf,#18
           sens1, sens2, sens3, spec1, spec2, spec3, #24
           diff_sens_217_217ab42,diff_sens_217_csf, diff_sens_217ab42_csf,
           tp1, fp1, tn1, fn1, tp2, fp2, tn2, fn2, tp3, fp3, tn3, fn3)) #31 #35 #39)) #27
} 

set.seed(12345)
boot_results_2cp <- boot(data = df.outlier, statistic = f_comp_stats_2cp, R = 2000)

##Calculate pvalues two cutoffs
stat_indices <- list(
```

```{r statistical analyses, outliers VR outcome}
##AUC differences with DeLong

df$petstat <- as.factor(df$VR_overall)

biomarkers <- c("PL_217_42","ptau217", "csf_4240")
results_delong <- list()
index <- 1

library(pROC)

for (i in seq_along(biomarkers)){
  for (j in seq_along(biomarkers)){ 
    if (i < j) {
      predictor1 <- biomarkers[i]
      predictor2 <- biomarkers[j]
      
      formula1 <- as.formula(paste("petstat~",predictor1, collapse=""))
      formula2 <- as.formula(paste("petstat~",predictor2, collapse=""))
      
      roc_curve1 <- pROC::roc(formula1, data=df, quiet=T)
      roc_curve2 <- pROC::roc(formula2, data=df,quiet=T)
      
      res <- roc.test(roc_curve1, roc_curve2, method = "delong")
      
      long <- data.frame(
        comp = paste(predictor1, predictor2, sep=" vs. "),
        auc1a = round(roc_curve1$auc,3),
        auc2a = round(roc_curve2$auc,3),
        pval = round(res$p.value,3),
        auc1_ci_low = round(ci.auc(roc_curve1)[1],3),
        auc1_ci_high =round(ci.auc(roc_curve1)[3],3),
        auc2_ci_low =round(ci.auc(roc_curve2)[1],3),
        auc2_ci_high = round(ci.auc(roc_curve2)[3],3)
      )
      
      results_delong[[length(results_delong) + 1]] <- long
      index <- index + 1
    }
  }
}

results_delong$padj <- round(p.adjust(results_delong$pval, method = "fdr"),3)

results_delong$auc_order_ci_low <- c(results_delong$auc1_ci_low[1],results_delong$auc1_ci_low[3], results_delong$auc2_ci_low[3])
results_delong$auc_order_ci_high <- c(results_delong$auc1_ci_high[1],results_delong$auc1_ci_high[3], results_delong$auc2_ci_high[3])

                     file="~/DELONG_VR_outliers.xlsx")

##Calculate Accuracy, PPV, NPV and 95% CIs

f_comp_stats <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data[indices,])
  
  ##threshold calculation related to d, and then assign binary status based on that threshold
  compute_metrics <- function(true, pred) {
    
    ##threshold calculation and 
    
    v_tp <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 1)
    v_fp <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 1)
    v_tn <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 0)
    v_fn <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 0)
    
    sens <- v_tp / (v_tp + v_fn)
    spec <- v_tn / (v_tn + v_fp)
    acc <- (v_tp + v_tn) / (v_tp + v_tn + v_fn + v_fp)
    ppv <- cutpointr::ppv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    npv <- cutpointr::npv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    
    return(c(acc, ppv, npv, sens, spec, v_tp, v_fp, v_tn, v_fn))
  }
  
  test_columns <- c("ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  results <- matrix(nrow = length(test_columns), ncol = 9)
  colnames(results) <- c("Accuracy", "PPV", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN")
  rownames(results) <- c("PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_columns)) {
    results[i, ] <- round(compute_metrics(d$petstat, d[[test_columns[i]]]),3)
  }
  
  #Assign p-tau217/AB42 metrics
  acc1 <- results[1,1]
  ppv1 <- results[1,2]
  npv1 <- results[1,3]
  sens1 <- results[1,4]
  spec1 <- results[1,5]
  tp1 <- results[1,6]
  fp1 <- results[1,7]
  tn1 <- results[1,8]
  fn1 <- results[1,9]
  
  #Assign CSF metrics
  acc2 <- results[2,1]
  ppv2 <- results[2,2]
  npv2 <- results[2,3]
  sens2 <- results[2,4]
  spec2 <- results[2,5]
  tp2 <- results[2,6]
  fp2 <- results[2,7]
  tn2 <- results[2,8]
  fn2 <- results[2,9]
  
  #p-tau217 vs. 217/ab42
  diff_acc <- acc1 - acc2
  diff_ppv <- ppv1 - ppv2
  diff_npv <- npv1 - npv2
  diff_sens <- sens1 - sens2

  
  return(c(acc1, acc2, ppv1, ppv2, npv1, npv2,#6
           diff_acc, diff_ppv, diff_npv, diff_sens,#10
           sens1, sens2, spec1, spec2, diff_sens, #15
           tp1, fp1, tn1, fn1, tp2, fp2, tn2, fn2)) #23
}   

set.seed(12345)
boot_results <- boot(data = df, statistic = f_comp_stats, R = 2000)

}

###Function to bootstrap %intermediate
f_greyzone <- function(data, indices){
  d <- data[indices, ]
  
  test_bio <- c("PL_217_42", "csf_ab4240")
  pred_pos <- c("ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  pred_neg <- c("ptau217ab42_neg", "ab4240_pos2")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_bio)) {
    greyzone_col <- paste0("greyzone_", test_bio[i])
    neg_col <- pred_neg[i]
    pos_col <- pred_pos[i]
    
    d <- d %>%
      mutate(!!greyzone_col := case_when(
        !!sym(neg_col) == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0
        !!sym(pos_col) == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1
        TRUE ~ 2
      ))  
  }
  
  int_n_ptau217ab42 <- length(which(d$greyzone_PL_217_42 ==2))
  int_perc_ptau217ab42 <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_PL_217_42 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
  
  int_n_csf <- length(which(d$greyzone_ab4240 ==2))
  int_perc_csf <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_ab4240 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
  
  #DIFFERENCES BETWEEN ASSAYS
  diff_perc_ptau217ab42_csf <- int_perc_ptau217ab42 - int_perc_csf
  
  return(c(int_perc_ptau217ab42,int_perc_csf, diff_perc_ptau217ab42_csf))
}

#Step 3: Two cutoff approach

f_comp_stats_2cp <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data[indices,])
  
  
  compute_metrics <- function(d,greyzone, true, pred) {
    
    dx <- d %>% filter(!!sym(greyzone) != 2)
    
    v_tp <- sum(dx[[true]] == 1 & dx[[pred]] == 1)
    v_fp <- sum(dx[[true]] == 0 & dx[[pred]] == 1)
    v_tn <- sum(dx[[true]] == 0 & dx[[pred]] == 0)
    v_fn <- sum(dx[[true]] == 1 & dx[[pred]] == 0)
    
    sens <- v_tp / (v_tp + v_fn)
    spec <- v_tn / (v_tn + v_fp)
    acc <- (v_tp + v_tn) / (v_tp + v_tn + v_fn + v_fp)
    ppv <- cutpointr::ppv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    npv <- cutpointr::npv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    
    return(c(acc, ppv, npv, sens, spec, v_tp, v_fp, v_tn, v_fn))
  }
  
  greyzones <- c("greyzone_ptau217ab42","greyzone_ab4240")
  test_columns <- c("ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  true_label <- "petstat"
  
  results <- matrix(nrow = length(test_columns), ncol =9)
  colnames(results) <- c("Accuracy", "PPV", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN")
  rownames(results) <- c("PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_columns)) {
    results[i, ] <- round(compute_metrics(d, greyzone = greyzones[i], true = true_label, pred = test_columns[i]),3)
  }
  
  #P-tau217/AB42
  acc1 <- results[1,1]
  ppv1 <- results[1,2]
  npv1 <- results[1,3]
  sens1 <- results[1,4]
  spec1 <- results[1,5]
  tp1 <- results[1,6]
  fp1 <- results[1,7]
  tn1 <- results[1,8]
  fn1 <- results[1,9]
  
  #CSF
  acc2 <- results[2,1]
  ppv2 <- results[2,2]
  npv2 <- results[2,3]
  sens2 <- results[2,4]
  spec2 <- results[2,5]
  tp2 <- results[2,6]
  fp2 <- results[2,7]
  tn2 <- results[2,8]
  fn2 <- results[2,9]
  
  #p-tau217 vs. 217/ab42
  diff_acc <- acc1 - acc2
  diff_ppv <- ppv1 - ppv2
  diff_npv <- npv1 - npv2
  diff_sens <- sens1 - sens2
  
  
  return(c(acc1, acc2, ppv1, ppv2, npv1, npv2,#6
           diff_acc, diff_ppv, diff_npv, diff_sens,#10
           sens1, sens2, spec1, spec2, diff_sens, #15
           tp1, fp1, tn1, fn1, tp2, fp2, tn2, fn2)) #23
} 

set.seed(12345)
boot_results_2cp <- boot(data = df, statistic = f_comp_stats_2cp, R = 2000)

##Calculate pvalues two cutoffs
stat_indices <- list(
  "Accuracy 217_AB42 vs. CSF" = 7,
  "PPV 217_AB42 vs. CSF" = 8,
  "NPV 217_AB42 vs. CSF" = 9)

pvals_2cp <- data.frame(
  Pval = numeric(length(stat_indices)),
  row.names = c("Accuracy 217_AB42 vs. CSF","PPV 217_AB42 vs. CSF","NPV 217_AB42 vs. CSF"))

bootstrap_replicates_2 <- boot_results_2cp$t
for (stat_name in names(stat_indices)) {
  index <- stat_indices[[stat_name]]
  boot_diff <- boot_results_2cp$t0[index]
  results_underH0_diff <- bootstrap_replicates_2[, index] - mean(bootstrap_replicates_2[, index])
  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_2cp[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}
```

#### Analyses VR AUC (ADNI)

```{r ADNI,AB-PET VR outcome}
##AUC differences with DeLong
df$petstat <- as.factor(df$VR)
df <- df %>% filter(PL_217_42 < 0.09)

#| echo: false
biomarkers <- c("PL_217_42","ptau217", "CSF_18142")
results_delong <- list()
index <- 1

library(pROC)

for (i in seq_along(biomarkers)){
  for (j in seq_along(biomarkers)){ 
    if (i < j) {
      predictor1 <- biomarkers[i]
      predictor2 <- biomarkers[j]
      
      formula1 <- as.formula(paste("petstat~",predictor1, collapse=""))
      formula2 <- as.formula(paste("petstat~",predictor2, collapse=""))
      
      roc_curve1 <- pROC::roc(formula1, data=df, quiet=T)
      roc_curve2 <- pROC::roc(formula2, data=df,quiet=T)
      
      res <- roc.test(roc_curve1, roc_curve2, method = "delong")
      
      long <- data.frame(
        comp = paste(predictor1, predictor2, sep=" vs. "),
        auc1a = round(roc_curve1$auc,3),
        auc2a = round(roc_curve2$auc,3),
        pval = round(res$p.value,3),
        auc1_ci_low = round(ci.auc(roc_curve1)[1],3),
        auc1_ci_high =round(ci.auc(roc_curve1)[3],3),
        auc2_ci_low =round(ci.auc(roc_curve2)[1],3),
        auc2_ci_high = round(ci.auc(roc_curve2)[3],3)
      )
      
      results_delong[[length(results_delong) + 1]] <- long
      index <- index + 1
    }
  }
}

results_delong <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, results_delong)
results_delong$padj <- round(p.adjust(results_delong$pval, method = "fdr"),3)
results_delong$auc_order <- c(results_delong$auc1a[1],results_delong$auc1a[3], results_delong$auc2a[3])
results_delong$auc_order_ci_low <- c(results_delong$auc1_ci_low[1],results_delong$auc1_ci_low[3], results_delong$auc2_ci_low[3])
results_delong$auc_order_ci_high <- c(results_delong$auc1_ci_high[1],results_delong$auc1_ci_high[3], results_delong$auc2_ci_high[3])
openxlsx::write.xlsx(results_delong,
```

```{r metrics ADNI}
df$petstat <- as.factor(df$VR)

df$ptau217ab42_pos <- ifelse(df$PL_217_42 >= 0.00738, 1, 0) 

df$csf_pos <- ifelse(df$CSF_18142 > 0.028, 1, 0)

###A. Metric comps FDA----
f_comp_stats <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data[indices,])
  
  ##threshold calculation related to d, and then assign binary status based on that threshold
  compute_metrics <- function(true, pred) {
    
    ##threshold calculation and 
    
    v_tp <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 1)
    v_fp <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 1)
    v_tn <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 0)
    v_fn <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 0)
    
    sens <- v_tp / (v_tp + v_fn)
    spec <- v_tn / (v_tn + v_fp)
    acc <- (v_tp + v_tn) / (v_tp + v_tn + v_fn + v_fp)
    ppv <- cutpointr::ppv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    npv <- cutpointr::npv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    
    return(c(acc, ppv, npv, sens, spec, v_tp, v_fp, v_tn, v_fn))#sens#spec
  }
  
  test_columns <- c("ptau217ab42_pos", "csf_pos")
  results <- matrix(nrow = length(test_columns), ncol = 9)
  colnames(results) <- c("Accuracy", "PPV", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN")
  rownames(results) <- c("PL_217_42", "CSF_18142")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_columns)) {
    results[i, ] <- round(compute_metrics(d$petstat, d[[test_columns[i]]]),3)
  }
  
  #Assign p-tau217/AB42 metrics
  acc1 <- results[1,1]
  ppv1 <- results[1,2]
  npv1 <- results[1,3]
  sens1 <- results[1,4]
  spec1 <- results[1,5]
  tp1 <- results[1,6]
  fp1 <- results[1,7]
  tn1 <- results[1,8]
  fn1 <- results[1,9]
  
  #Assign CSF metrics
  acc2 <- results[2,1]
  ppv2 <- results[2,2]
  npv2 <- results[2,3]
  sens2 <- results[2,4]
  spec2 <- results[2,5]
  tp2 <- results[2,6]
  fp2 <- results[2,7]
  tn2 <- results[2,8]
  fn2 <- results[2,9]
  
  #p-tau217 vs. 217/ab42
  diff_acc <- acc1 - acc2
  diff_ppv <- ppv1 - ppv2
  diff_npv <- npv1 - npv2
  diff_sens <- sens1 - sens2
  
  
  return(c(acc1, acc2, ppv1, ppv2, npv1, npv2,#6
           diff_acc, diff_ppv, diff_npv, diff_sens,#10
           sens1, sens2, spec1, spec2, diff_sens, #15
           tp1, fp1, tn1, fn1, tp2, fp2, tn2, fn2)) #23
}   

set.seed(12345)
boot_results <- boot(data = df, statistic = f_comp_stats, R = 2000)

#Calculate pvalues 1 cutoff
stat_indices <- list(
  "Accuracy 217_AB42 vs. CSF" = 7,
  "PPV 217_AB42 vs. CSF" = 8,
  "NPV 217_AB42 vs. CSF" = 9)

pvals_1cp <- data.frame(
  Pval = numeric(length(stat_indices)),
  row.names = c("Accuracy 217_AB42 vs. CSF","PPV 217_AB42 vs. CSF","NPV 217_AB42 vs. CSF"))

bootstrap_replicates <- boot_results$t
for (stat_name in names(stat_indices)) {
  index <- stat_indices[[stat_name]]
  boot_diff <- boot_results$t0[index]
  results_underH0_diff <- bootstrap_replicates[, index] - mean(bootstrap_replicates[, index])
  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_1cp[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

##Add outcomes to dataframe (function to establish dataframe as desired)
create_df <- function(method_name, boot_acc_index, boot_ppv_index, boot_npv_index, boot_sen_index, boot_spec_index,boot_tp_index,boot_fp_index,boot_tn_index,boot_fn_index) {
  data.frame(
    method = method_name,
    accuracy = round(boot_results$t0[boot_acc_index], 3),

    acc_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    PPV = round(boot_results$t0[boot_ppv_index], 3),
    ppv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    ppv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    NPV = round(boot_results$t0[boot_npv_index], 3),
    npv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    npv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Sensitivity =round(boot_results$t0[boot_sen_index], 3),
    sen_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    sen_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Specificity = round(boot_results$t0[boot_spec_index], 3),
    spec_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    spec_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    TP = round(boot_results$t0[boot_tp_index], 0),

    intermediate_n_percentage = NA,
    intermediate_n_percentage_low = NA,
    intermediate_n_percentage_high = NA,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    row.names = "1 Cutpoint"
  )
}
```

```{r metrics BFMC}
##Calculate Accuracy, PPV, NPV and 95% CIs

f_comp_stats <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data[indices,])
  
  ##threshold calculation related to d, and then assign binary status based on that threshold
  compute_metrics <- function(true, pred) {
    
    ##threshold calculation and 
    
    v_tp <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 1)
    v_fp <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 1)
    v_tn <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 0)
    v_fn <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 0)
    
    sens <- v_tp / (v_tp + v_fn)
    spec <- v_tn / (v_tn + v_fp)
    acc <- (v_tp + v_tn) / (v_tp + v_tn + v_fn + v_fp)
    ppv <- cutpointr::ppv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    npv <- cutpointr::npv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    
    return(c(acc, ppv, npv, sens, spec, v_tp, v_fp, v_tn, v_fn))
  }
  
  test_columns <- c("ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  results <- matrix(nrow = length(test_columns), ncol = 9)
  colnames(results) <- c("Accuracy", "PPV", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN")
  rownames(results) <- c("PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_columns)) {
    results[i, ] <- round(compute_metrics(d$petstat, d[[test_columns[i]]]),3)
  }
  
  #Assign p-tau217/AB42 metrics
  acc1 <- results[1,1]
  ppv1 <- results[1,2]
  npv1 <- results[1,3]
  sens1 <- results[1,4]
  spec1 <- results[1,5]
  tp1 <- results[1,6]
  fp1 <- results[1,7]
  tn1 <- results[1,8]
  fn1 <- results[1,9]
  
  #Assign CSF metrics
  acc2 <- results[2,1]
  ppv2 <- results[2,2]
  npv2 <- results[2,3]
  sens2 <- results[2,4]
  spec2 <- results[2,5]
  tp2 <- results[2,6]
  fp2 <- results[2,7]
  tn2 <- results[2,8]
  fn2 <- results[2,9]
  
  #p-tau217 vs. 217/ab42
  diff_acc <- acc1 - acc2
  diff_ppv <- ppv1 - ppv2
  diff_npv <- npv1 - npv2
  diff_sens <- sens1 - sens2

  
  return(c(acc1, acc2, ppv1, ppv2, npv1, npv2,#6
           diff_acc, diff_ppv, diff_npv, diff_sens,#10
           sens1, sens2, spec1, spec2, diff_sens, #15
           tp1, fp1, tn1, fn1, tp2, fp2, tn2, fn2)) #23
}   

set.seed(12345)

###Function to bootstrap %intermediate
f_greyzone <- function(data, indices){
  d <- data[indices, ]
  
  test_bio <- c("PL_217_42", "csf_ab4240")
  pred_pos <- c("ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  pred_neg <- c("ptau217ab42_neg", "ab4240_pos2")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_bio)) {
    greyzone_col <- paste0("greyzone_", test_bio[i])
    neg_col <- pred_neg[i]
    pos_col <- pred_pos[i]
    
    d <- d %>%
      mutate(!!greyzone_col := case_when(
        !!sym(neg_col) == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0
        !!sym(pos_col) == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1
        TRUE ~ 2
      ))  
  }
  
  int_n_ptau217ab42 <- length(which(d$greyzone_PL_217_42 ==2))
  int_perc_ptau217ab42 <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_PL_217_42 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
  
  int_n_csf <- length(which(d$greyzone_ab4240 ==2))
  int_perc_csf <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_ab4240 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
  
  #DIFFERENCES BETWEEN ASSAYS
  diff_perc_ptau217ab42_csf <- int_perc_ptau217ab42 - int_perc_csf
  
  return(c(int_perc_ptau217ab42,int_perc_csf, diff_perc_ptau217ab42_csf))
}

set.seed(12345)

  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_intermediate[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

#Step 3: Two cutoff approach

f_comp_stats_2cp <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data[indices,])
  
  
  compute_metrics <- function(d,greyzone, true, pred) {
    
    dx <- d %>% filter(!!sym(greyzone) != 2)
    
    v_tp <- sum(dx[[true]] == 1 & dx[[pred]] == 1)
    v_fp <- sum(dx[[true]] == 0 & dx[[pred]] == 1)
    v_tn <- sum(dx[[true]] == 0 & dx[[pred]] == 0)
    v_fn <- sum(dx[[true]] == 1 & dx[[pred]] == 0)
    
    sens <- v_tp / (v_tp + v_fn)
    spec <- v_tn / (v_tn + v_fp)
    acc <- (v_tp + v_tn) / (v_tp + v_tn + v_fn + v_fp)
    ppv <- cutpointr::ppv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    npv <- cutpointr::npv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    
    return(c(acc, ppv, npv, sens, spec, v_tp, v_fp, v_tn, v_fn))
  }
  
  greyzones <- c("greyzone_ptau217ab42","greyzone_ab4240")
  test_columns <- c("ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  true_label <- "petstat"
  
  results <- matrix(nrow = length(test_columns), ncol =9)
  colnames(results) <- c("Accuracy", "PPV", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN")
  rownames(results) <- c("PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_columns)) {
    results[i, ] <- round(compute_metrics(d, greyzone = greyzones[i], true = true_label, pred = test_columns[i]),3)
  }
  
  #P-tau217/AB42
  acc1 <- results[1,1]
  ppv1 <- results[1,2]
  npv1 <- results[1,3]
  sens1 <- results[1,4]
  spec1 <- results[1,5]
  tp1 <- results[1,6]
  fp1 <- results[1,7]
  tn1 <- results[1,8]
  fn1 <- results[1,9]
  
  #CSF
  acc2 <- results[2,1]
  ppv2 <- results[2,2]
  npv2 <- results[2,3]
  sens2 <- results[2,4]
  spec2 <- results[2,5]
  tp2 <- results[2,6]
  fp2 <- results[2,7]
  tn2 <- results[2,8]
  fn2 <- results[2,9]
  
  #p-tau217 vs. 217/ab42
  diff_acc <- acc1 - acc2
  diff_ppv <- ppv1 - ppv2
  diff_npv <- npv1 - npv2
  diff_sens <- sens1 - sens2
  
  
  return(c(acc1, acc2, ppv1, ppv2, npv1, npv2,#6
           diff_acc, diff_ppv, diff_npv, diff_sens,#10
           sens1, sens2, spec1, spec2, diff_sens, #15
           tp1, fp1, tn1, fn1, tp2, fp2, tn2, fn2)) #23
} 

set.seed(12345)
boot_results_2cp <- boot(data = df, statistic = f_comp_stats_2cp, R = 2000)

  )
}
```

```{r metrics BFMC}
#| echo: false

df$petstat <- as.factor(df$VR_overall)

df$ptau217ab42_pos <- ifelse(df$PL_217_42 >= 0.00738, 1, 0) 
df$ptau217ab42_neg <- ifelse(df$PL_217_42 <= 0.00370, 0, 1)

##Calculate Accuracy, PPV, NPV and 95% CIs

f_comp_stats <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data[indices,])
  
  ##threshold calculation related to d, and then assign binary status based on that threshold
  compute_metrics <- function(true, pred) {
    
    ##threshold calculation and 
    
    v_tp <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 1)
    v_fp <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 1)
    v_tn <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 0)
    v_fn <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 0)
    
    sens <- v_tp / (v_tp + v_fn)
    spec <- v_tn / (v_tn + v_fp)
    acc <- (v_tp + v_tn) / (v_tp + v_tn + v_fn + v_fp)
    ppv <- cutpointr::ppv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    npv <- cutpointr::npv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    
    return(c(acc, ppv, npv, sens, spec, v_tp, v_fp, v_tn, v_fn))
  }
  
  test_columns <- c("ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  results <- matrix(nrow = length(test_columns), ncol = 9)
  colnames(results) <- c("Accuracy", "PPV", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN")
  rownames(results) <- c("PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_columns)) {
    results[i, ] <- round(compute_metrics(d$petstat, d[[test_columns[i]]]),3)
  }
  
  #Assign p-tau217/AB42 metrics
  acc1 <- results[1,1]
  ppv1 <- results[1,2]
  npv1 <- results[1,3]
  sens1 <- results[1,4]
  spec1 <- results[1,5]
  tp1 <- results[1,6]
  fp1 <- results[1,7]
  tn1 <- results[1,8]
  fn1 <- results[1,9]
  
  #Assign CSF metrics
  acc2 <- results[2,1]
  ppv2 <- results[2,2]
  npv2 <- results[2,3]
  sens2 <- results[2,4]
  spec2 <- results[2,5]
  tp2 <- results[2,6]
  fp2 <- results[2,7]
  tn2 <- results[2,8]
  fn2 <- results[2,9]
  
  #p-tau217 vs. 217/ab42
  diff_acc <- acc1 - acc2
  diff_ppv <- ppv1 - ppv2
  diff_npv <- npv1 - npv2
  diff_sens <- sens1 - sens2

  
  return(c(acc1, acc2, ppv1, ppv2, npv1, npv2,#6
           diff_acc, diff_ppv, diff_npv, diff_sens,#10
           sens1, sens2, spec1, spec2, diff_sens, #15
           tp1, fp1, tn1, fn1, tp2, fp2, tn2, fn2)) #23
}   

set.seed(12345)

  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_1cp[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

##Add outcomes to dataframe (function to establish dataframe as desired)
create_df <- function(method_name, boot_acc_index, boot_ppv_index, boot_npv_index, boot_sen_index, boot_spec_index,boot_tp_index,boot_fp_index,boot_tn_index,boot_fn_index) {
  data.frame(
    method = method_name,
    accuracy = round(boot_results$t0[boot_acc_index], 3),
    acc_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    acc_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    PPV = round(boot_results$t0[boot_ppv_index], 3),

    ppv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    NPV = round(boot_results$t0[boot_npv_index], 3),
    npv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    npv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Sensitivity =round(boot_results$t0[boot_sen_index], 3),
    sen_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),

    Specificity = round(boot_results$t0[boot_spec_index], 3),
    spec_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    spec_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    TP = round(boot_results$t0[boot_tp_index], 0),

    TN = round(boot_results$t0[boot_tn_index], 0),

    intermediate_n_percentage = NA,
    intermediate_n_percentage_low = NA,
    intermediate_n_percentage_high = NA,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    row.names = "1 Cutpoint"
  )
}

df <- df %>%
  mutate(greyzone_ptau217ab42 = case_when(
    ptau217ab42_neg == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0
    ptau217ab42_pos == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1

df <- df %>%
  mutate(greyzone_ab4240 = case_when(
    ab4240_pos == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0 # so when they're negative 0.072
    ab4240_pos2 == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1 #so when they're positive even 0.058
    TRUE ~ 2                     # Intermediate values
  ))

#table(df$greyzone_ab4240)

###Function to bootstrap %intermediate
f_greyzone <- function(data, indices){
  d <- data[indices, ]
  
  test_bio <- c("PL_217_42", "csf_ab4240")
  pred_pos <- c("ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  pred_neg <- c("ptau217ab42_neg", "ab4240_pos2")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_bio)) {
    greyzone_col <- paste0("greyzone_", test_bio[i])
    neg_col <- pred_neg[i]
    pos_col <- pred_pos[i]
    
    d <- d %>%
      mutate(!!greyzone_col := case_when(
        !!sym(neg_col) == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0
        !!sym(pos_col) == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1
        TRUE ~ 2
      ))  
  }
  
  int_n_ptau217ab42 <- length(which(d$greyzone_PL_217_42 ==2))
  int_perc_ptau217ab42 <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_PL_217_42 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
  
  int_n_csf <- length(which(d$greyzone_ab4240 ==2))
  int_perc_csf <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_ab4240 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
  
  #DIFFERENCES BETWEEN ASSAYS
  diff_perc_ptau217ab42_csf <- int_perc_ptau217ab42 - int_perc_csf
  
  return(c(int_perc_ptau217ab42,int_perc_csf, diff_perc_ptau217ab42_csf))
}

set.seed(12345)
boot_results_greyzone <- boot(data = df, statistic = f_greyzone, R = 2000)

##Calculate pvalue %intermediate differences
stat_indices <- list("Int% pval p-tau217/AB42 vs.CSF" = 3)

pvals_intermediate <- data.frame(
  Pval = numeric(length(stat_indices)),
  row.names = c("Int% pval p-tau217/AB42 vs.CSF"))

bootstrap_replicates_grey <- boot_results_greyzone$t

for (stat_name in names(stat_indices)) {
  index <- stat_indices[[stat_name]]
  boot_diff <- boot_results_greyzone$t0[index]
  results_underH0_diff <- bootstrap_replicates_grey[, index] - mean(bootstrap_replicates_grey[, index])
  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_intermediate[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

#Step 3: Two cutoff approach

f_comp_stats_2cp <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data[indices,])
  
  
  compute_metrics <- function(d,greyzone, true, pred) {
    
    dx <- d %>% filter(!!sym(greyzone) != 2)
    
    v_tp <- sum(dx[[true]] == 1 & dx[[pred]] == 1)
    v_fp <- sum(dx[[true]] == 0 & dx[[pred]] == 1)
    v_tn <- sum(dx[[true]] == 0 & dx[[pred]] == 0)
    v_fn <- sum(dx[[true]] == 1 & dx[[pred]] == 0)
    
    sens <- v_tp / (v_tp + v_fn)
    spec <- v_tn / (v_tn + v_fp)
    acc <- (v_tp + v_tn) / (v_tp + v_tn + v_fn + v_fp)
    ppv <- cutpointr::ppv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    npv <- cutpointr::npv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    
    return(c(acc, ppv, npv, sens, spec, v_tp, v_fp, v_tn, v_fn))
  }
  
  greyzones <- c("greyzone_ptau217ab42","greyzone_ab4240")
  test_columns <- c("ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  true_label <- "petstat"
  
  results <- matrix(nrow = length(test_columns), ncol =9)
  colnames(results) <- c("Accuracy", "PPV", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN")
  rownames(results) <- c("PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_columns)) {
    results[i, ] <- round(compute_metrics(d, greyzone = greyzones[i], true = true_label, pred = test_columns[i]),3)
  }
  
  #P-tau217/AB42
  acc1 <- results[1,1]
  ppv1 <- results[1,2]
  npv1 <- results[1,3]
  sens1 <- results[1,4]
  spec1 <- results[1,5]
  tp1 <- results[1,6]
  fp1 <- results[1,7]
  tn1 <- results[1,8]
  fn1 <- results[1,9]
  
  #CSF
  acc2 <- results[2,1]
  ppv2 <- results[2,2]
  npv2 <- results[2,3]
  sens2 <- results[2,4]
  spec2 <- results[2,5]
  tp2 <- results[2,6]
  fp2 <- results[2,7]
  tn2 <- results[2,8]
  fn2 <- results[2,9]
  
  #p-tau217 vs. 217/ab42
  diff_acc <- acc1 - acc2
  diff_ppv <- ppv1 - ppv2
  diff_npv <- npv1 - npv2
  diff_sens <- sens1 - sens2
  
  
  return(c(acc1, acc2, ppv1, ppv2, npv1, npv2,#6
           diff_acc, diff_ppv, diff_npv, diff_sens,#10
           sens1, sens2, spec1, spec2, diff_sens, #15
           tp1, fp1, tn1, fn1, tp2, fp2, tn2, fn2)) #23
} 

set.seed(12345)
boot_results_2cp <- boot(data = df, statistic = f_comp_stats_2cp, R = 2000)

##Calculate pvalues two cutoffs
stat_indices <- list(
  "Accuracy 217_AB42 vs. CSF" = 7,
  "PPV 217_AB42 vs. CSF" = 8,
  "NPV 217_AB42 vs. CSF" = 9)

pvals_2cp <- data.frame(
  Pval = numeric(length(stat_indices)),
  row.names = c("Accuracy 217_AB42 vs. CSF","PPV 217_AB42 vs. CSF","NPV 217_AB42 vs. CSF"))

bootstrap_replicates_2 <- boot_results_2cp$t
for (stat_name in names(stat_indices)) {
  index <- stat_indices[[stat_name]]
  boot_diff <- boot_results_2cp$t0[index]
  results_underH0_diff <- bootstrap_replicates_2[, index] - mean(bootstrap_replicates_2[, index])
  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_2cp[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

##Add results to dataframe
create_df_2 <- function(method_name, boot_acc_index, boot_ppv_index, boot_npv_index,boot_grey_index,boot_sen_index, boot_spec_index,boot_tp_index,boot_fp_index,boot_tn_index,boot_fn_index) {
  data.frame(
    method = method_name,
    accuracy = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_acc_index], 3),
    acc_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    acc_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    PPV = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_ppv_index], 3),
    ppv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    ppv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    NPV = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_npv_index], 3),
    npv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    npv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Sensitivity =round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_sen_index], 3),
    sen_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    sen_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Specificity = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_spec_index], 3),
    spec_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    spec_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    TP = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_tp_index], 0),
    FP = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_fp_index], 0),
    TN = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_tn_index], 0),
    FN = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_fn_index], 0),
    intermediate_n_percentage = round(boot_results_greyzone$t0[boot_grey_index],3),
    intermediate_n_percentage_low = round(quantile(boot_results_greyzone$t[, boot_grey_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    intermediate_n_percentage_high = round(quantile(boot_results_greyzone$t[, boot_grey_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    row.names = "2 Cutpoints"
  )
}

results_2cp_2 <- create_df_2(method_name = "Plasma p-tau217/AB42",boot_acc_index = 1,boot_ppv_index = 3,boot_npv_index = 5, boot_grey_index = 1, boot_sen_index=11, boot_spec_index=13,boot_tp_index = 16, boot_fp_index=17, boot_tn_index=18, boot_fn_index=19)
```
